executive_summary: Build failed due to 2 compilation errors: method signature mismatch in TaskController where getUserTasks is called with incorrect parameter types (int, int instead of Pageable), and an illegal override attempt in TaskStatus enum trying to override the final name() method from java.lang.Enum.

errors.message: method getUserTasks cannot be applied to given types; required: Long,Pageable found: Long,int,int
errors.root_cause: The controller is calling taskService.getUserTasks() with three parameters (Long userId, int page, int size) but the service interface expects only two parameters (Long userId, Pageable pageable). The pagination parameters need to be wrapped in a Pageable object.
errors.fix_recommendation: Replace the method call at line 45 with: taskService.getUserTasks(userId, PageRequest.of(page, size)). Import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest at the top of the file.

errors.message: name() in TaskStatus cannot override name() in java.lang.Enum; overridden method is final
errors.root_cause: The TaskStatus enum is attempting to override the final name() method inherited from java.lang.Enum. The name() method in Enum is final and cannot be overridden by design.
errors.fix_recommendation: Remove the name() method override from TaskStatus.java at line 11. If custom naming is needed, create a separate method like getDisplayName() or use the @JsonValue annotation on a custom field instead of overriding name().
